{{Quote|Our work identified the looping hyperspace lanes within the Stygian Caldera that contain the planets of the Sith Empire. The Nache Bhelfia route links Ziost, Khar Delba, Rhelg, Krayiss, and Korriban&mdash;the five worlds most sacred to the Sith.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''Nache Bhelfia''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] loop in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]]. It linked the five sacred [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] worlds: [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Khar Delba]], [[Rhelg/Legends|Rhelg]], [[Krayiss II]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and the lesser worlds of [[Nicht Ka]] and [[Ch'hodos]].<ref name="TEA" />

Following the [[Discovery of Korriban]] in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Jedi [[Exiles]] [[Sorzus Syn]] and [[Remulus Dreypa]] mapped the Nache Bhelfia hyperlane. Sorzus Syn later wrote of the hyperlane in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]], which was later collected by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] into [[Gender/Legends|his]] ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BoS" />
